gdnPrefill.change: The pinned head-major convolution consumer passes immutable original token rows into a validated direct-row view. A shared const-generic kernel body loads the same raw projections into the existing NEON FMA/SiLU/history register sequence and writes transformed outputs once.
gdnPrefill.scope: The staging omission selects only the existing Windows ARM64 baseline-NEON width-4, four-aligned-channel, multi-token path. Single-token, unsupported-target and unsupported-shape fallback retain complete raw staging and the old failure publication. Graph cancellation callback positions and transactional discard remain unchanged.
gdnPrefill.sourceWorkAvoided: At Swift's 10240 convolution channels and 48 recurrent layers, a 32-token tile omits 62914560 bytes (60 MiB) of raw staging stores plus the same nominal copied-read payload. These are source copy counts, not measured DRAM traffic, generated instructions or latency.
gdnPrefill.controls: Three new controls cover an independent scalar FMA/SiLU and history-bit oracle, 0/1/2/8/16/32 tokens, 1/4/8/12/65/128 channels, 1/2/4/5 taps, signed zero and subnormal inputs, immutable source rows, malformed geometry before mutation and complete copied-route failure publication. Dependent native-capture and synthetic full-graph state/adapter/recovery controls are selected separately.

suffixMatching.change: A reversed bounded suffix prefix table and Z-box reuse retain matches already proved at earlier ends, preserving longest-match, most-recent tie and overlapping-span semantics. Public proposal allocation and the internal fixed proposal buffer are unchanged.
suffixMatching.sourceWorkBound: The additional private table is [u8; 64], or 64 source bytes. The prefix and history scans together perform fewer than 2*(history length + selected maximum window) token equalities. This bounds worst-case matching work without establishing common-case request benefit or actual stack size.
suffixMatching.controls: Two new exact controls count the actual production predicate, compare an 8K adversarial near-match against the independent old scan, and cover periodic, broken-period, maximum-window, tie and overlap cases. The fixed inventory also retains the independent exhaustive length-first oracle, invalid-config/no-write checks and dependent greedy correction/cancellation controls.

transientNativeQ2.change: Eligible single-operation transient token tiles reuse one call-local packed-weight vector when residency is absent or refused. Original ordered N=1 submissions and per-token validation, output allocation, completion and failure accounting remain intact.
transientNativeQ2.sourceWorkAvoided: An 8/16/32-token tile omits 7/15/31 full host weight-transcoding passes and corresponding packing-vector allocations. Queue writes and operation counts are unchanged. Resident and multi-operation tiled routes retain their existing scheduling; no persistent expansion or new DSP kernel is introduced.
transientNativeQ2.controls: Two new mock controls cover independent two-bit digit layout and original-PQ2 scalar output, fourth-symbol values, absent/refused residency, 0/1/8/16/32 tokens and 32/64 rows. They check one-byte-under admission, input/scale failure precedence, late invalid inputs, submit and nonfinite-output failures, clearing, counters and terminal refusal. Cross-review corrected the positive-but-insufficient mock resident capacity before any workload.
transientNativeQ2.resources: Existing conservative payload, cache, queue, operation, deadline, failure terminality and teardown policies remain. Host-only mock execution does not qualify vendor lifecycle, signed arithmetic, placement or NPU benefit.

No dependency update, forced unification or blanket analyzer suppression.
